However, biosimilar competition for blockbuster drugs and dependence on partner revenues remain concerns.

RHHBY.title: Roche's Enicepatide Shows Weight Loss, HbA1c Gains in Phase II Study
RHHBY.summary: Roche reported positive Phase II results for enicepatide, its once-weekly dual GLP-1/GIP receptor agonist, showing dose-dependent HbA1c reductions of 2.65% and body weight loss of 15.5% at the 24 mg dose in type 2 diabetes patients. The drug was well-tolerated with minimal discontinuations. Roche is advancing two Phase III weight-management studies and plans to initiate Phase III glycemic-control and cardiovascular trials in H1 2027, positioning itself to compete in the growing obesity therapeutics market dominated by Eli Lilly and Novo Nordisk.

RHHBY.title: Global Alzheimer’s Disease Biomarker Market Poised for Phenomenal Expansion at a Growth Rate of ~9% by 2034 | DelveInsight
RHHBY.summary: The global Alzheimer's disease biomarker market is projected to grow from USD 2.2 billion in 2025 to USD 4.7 billion by 2034, driven by rising disease prevalence, aging populations, and advancements in blood-based biomarkers like phosphorylated tau and amyloid-beta assays. North America leads the market with 41% share, while Asia-Pacific is the fastest-growing region. Recent FDA clearances and expanded laboratory testing availability are accelerating market adoption.

RHHBY.title: Zealand Pharma announces initiation of the registrational Phase 3 ZUPREME program of petrelintide in people with overweight or obesity
RHHBY.summary: Zealand Pharma announced the initiation of its global Phase 3 ZUPREME program for petrelintide, a once-weekly injectable treatment for weight management. The program consists of three trials enrolling approximately 7,000 participants across different patient populations. The Phase 3 advancement is based on positive Phase 2 results showing double-digit weight loss with a tolerability profile comparable to placebo. The development is being conducted in partnership with Roche.

RHHBY.title: CHMP Backs CORT's Lifyorli Combo in Platinum-Resistant Ovarian Cancer
RHHBY.summary: Corcept Therapeutics announced that the European Medicines Agency's CHMP committee issued a positive opinion recommending approval of Lifyorli (relacorilant) combined with nab-paclitaxel for platinum-resistant ovarian cancer treatment. The recommendation will be reviewed by the European Commission with a final decision expected in Q4 2026. Lifyorli generated $47.6 million in Q2 2026, its first quarter of commercial availability. The company is also studying relacorilant for other solid tumors and resubmitted an NDA for Cushing's syndrome treatment.

RHHBY.title: Magnetic Bead Purification Kits Market Outlook 2026-2030: Investment Trends, Strategic Profiles and Revenue Share Outlook
RHHBY.summary: The global magnetic bead purification kits market reached $4.08 billion in 2025 with an 11.6% CAGR and is projected to grow to $6.73 billion by 2030 (10.5% CAGR) and $10.42 billion by 2035 (9.1% CAGR). Growth is driven by expanding genomics research, molecular diagnostics, and high-throughput screening. Semi-automated kits dominate at 51.8% market share, while Asia-Pacific is the fastest-growing region at 12% CAGR. Key challenges include skilled labor shortages and automation infrastructure dependencies.

PAYX.summary: Paychex introduced WISE Hire, an AI-powered recruiting platform that helps businesses find and hire qualified talent 4x faster on average. The solution combines AI agents for candidate sourcing, recruiting workflow automation, and hiring coaching while maintaining human oversight and decision-making authority. WISE Hire is available as a standalone offering or integrated within Paychex's HCM platforms and can access major job channels including Google for Jobs and Meta's local jobs marketplace.

While the company sees a $300B+ addressable market and leverages AI across 82 million consumers and 10 million businesses, new customer acquisition fell short of expectations in fiscal 2026. Management guides fiscal 2027 revenue growth of 9%-10% while continuing to invest in scaling these growth engines.

VSAT.title: Viasat Wins First Task Order Award as part of $307 Million Ceiling U.S. Marine Corps Enterprise Services Contract for Multi-Orbit Connectivity
VSAT.summary: Viasat Inc. has been awarded an initial $42 million task order under a seven-year, up to $307 million IDIQ contract to provide fully managed, end-to-end global satellite services for the United States Marine Corps. The contract covers multi-orbit connectivity across L-, Ku, and Ka-bands, including access to Viasat's next-generation ViaSat-3 satellites, with 24x7x365 network and security operations support.

HPQ.title: Magnite Named Primary Video Ad Server and a Programmatic Technology Provider for HP TV+
HPQ.summary: Magnite announced it will serve as the primary video ad server and programmatic technology provider for HP TV+, HP's free ad-supported streaming service for PCs. INTC.summary: A $1,000 investment in Nvidia made in September 2016 would be worth $140,228.18 as of September 22, 2026, representing a 13,922.82% gain. Nvidia continues to benefit from strong demand for accelerated computing and AI infrastructure, though the company faces risks from China market closure, customer concentration, and rising competition.

INTC.title: Can Intel's Core Ultra Expansion With Googlebook Benefit the Stock?
INTC.summary: Intel has extended its Core Ultra platform to new Googlebook laptops from Acer, ASUS, and Lenovo, powered by Intel Core Ultra Series 3 processors built on 18A process technology. These processors integrate CPU, GPU, and NPU architectures for AI-enabled workloads and feature enhanced connectivity including Wi-Fi 7, Bluetooth 6.0, and Thunderbolt. Intel faces competition from Qualcomm's Snapdragon X2 and AMD's Ryzen AI processors in the growing AI PC market.

INTC.title: The Global Semiconductor Market Accelerates as AI Computing, Advanced Nodes and Automotive Electronics Reshape Global Chip Demand

INTC.title: Tech Stocks Break Out: The Next Leg of the Bull Market

Bitcoin's rally signals returning risk appetite among investors.

ORKA.title: Oruka Therapeutics Announces Positive Week 28 Data for ORKA-001 from the Ongoing EVERLAST-A Trial Showing Deepening of Responses Without Additional Dosing
ORKA.summary: Oruka Therapeutics reported positive Week 28 interim data from its EVERLAST-A Phase 2a trial of ORKA-001, an IL-23p19 monoclonal antibody for plaque psoriasis. The drug demonstrated deepening clinical responses with 71.4% of patients achieving PASI 100 (complete skin clearance) and 87.3% achieving PASI 90, six months after the last dose with no additional dosing beyond Week 4. The drug maintained a favorable safety profile consistent with the IL-23 class. Full 52-week data is expected in December 2026.

The company raised its full-year 2026 organic revenue growth outlook to 13%-13.5%, driven by strength in messaging, voice, and software add-ons. However, with unchanged earnings estimate revisions over the past 30 days, analysts caution that the stock may struggle to sustain momentum without further positive estimate revisions.

CRWV.title: IREN Broadens Its AI Customer Base: Can Diversification Pay Off?
CRWV.summary: IREN Limited is diversifying its AI cloud customer base away from heavy dependence on Microsoft and NVIDIA by signing $2.8 billion in contracts with Prometheus, Perplexity, and Together AI in July 2026. The company is experiencing stronger contract economics with three-year pricing up 125% and five-year pricing up 70%, though it faces risks from early-stage customers and shorter contracts. With 2026 capacity largely sold out, IREN is targeting broader customer expansion for 2027-2028.

GLW.title: INVESTOR ALERT: Pomerantz Law Firm Investigates Claims On Behalf of Investors of Corning Incorporated - GLW
GLW.summary: Pomerantz LLP is investigating potential securities fraud claims against Corning Incorporated following the company's announcement of a $2 billion at-the-market equity offering with Goldman Sachs on September 11, 2026. The announcement triggered a significant stock price decline of $22.80 per share (13.7%) to $143.60 on September 14, 2026. Investors are being invited to join the class action investigation.

GLW.title: Ciena Expands Global Subsea Footprint With ACE & ECHO Upgrades
GLW.summary: Ciena Corporation has secured two major subsea cable deployments: upgrading the 17,000-km ACE route with 30+ Tb/s capacity using its WL6e technology, and deploying WL6e on FLAG's ECHO trans-Pacific cable system. The company's WL6e adoption has surpassed WL5e, and its disaggregated line systems hold roughly 70% market share. Ciena trades at a forward P/E of 37.35 and holds a Zacks Rank #1 (Strong Buy) rating.

GLW.title: Here's How Much You'd Have If You Invested $1000 in Corning a Decade Ago
GLW.summary: A $1,000 investment in Corning (GLW) made in September 2016 would be worth $6,924.22 by September 2026, representing a 592.42% gain, significantly outperforming the S&P 500's 258.96% return. The company benefits from strong demand in AI infrastructure and optical connectivity, with second-quarter results exceeding expectations. However, exposure to cyclical markets, customer concentration, and tariff uncertainty present headwinds.

BIDU.title: רוזן, עו"ד מהימן למשקיעים, מעודד את משקיעי Baidu, Inc. לשכור ייצוג משפטי לקראת מועד חשוב בתביעה ייצוגית בניירות הערך – BIDU
BIDU.summary: Rosen Law Firm has filed a class action securities lawsuit on behalf of Baidu, Inc. (NASDAQ: BIDU) investors who purchased securities between November 18, 2025 and August 17, 2026. The lawsuit alleges that Baidu made false or misleading statements regarding its AI capabilities and overstated its ability to offset declines in its traditional online marketing business, resulting in material misrepresentations about the company's business prospects. Investors who purchased Baidu securities during the class period may be eligible for compensation.

AARD.title: מועד אחרון לתביעה ייצוגית נגד AARDVARK: רוזן, יועץ למשקיעים מיומן, קורא למשקיעי Aardvark Therapeutics, Inc. לשכור ייצוג משפטי לקראת מועד חשוב בתביעה ייצוגית בניירות הערך – AARD
AARD.summary: The Rosen Law Firm announced a securities class action lawsuit against Aardvark Therapeutics, Inc. (AARD) for allegedly making false and misleading statements regarding the safety profile of its drug ARD-101 and overstating its clinical, regulatory, and commercial prospects. The lawsuit covers investors who purchased securities between February 13, 2025 (IPO date) and May 14, 2026. The deadline to file a claim is October 13, 2026.

AARD.title: Deadline Alert: Aardvark Therapeutics, Inc. (AARD) Shareholders Who Lost Money Urged To Contact Glancy Prongay Wolke & Rotter LLP About Securities Fraud Lawsuit
AARD.summary: Aardvark Therapeutics faces a securities fraud class action lawsuit covering the period February 10, 2025 to May 14, 2026. The company voluntarily paused its Phase 3 HERO trial in February 2026 due to cardiac safety concerns, causing a 56.2% stock decline. In May 2026, the FDA placed a full clinical hold on the drug ARD-101, resulting in a further 32.1% stock drop. Investors who suffered losses are urged to file lead plaintiff motions by October 13, 2026.

DVLT.title: מועד אחרון לתביעה ייצוגית נגד DATAVAULT AI: רוזן, יועץ למשקיעים מהימן, קורא למשקיעי Datavault AI Inc. לשכור ייצוג משפטי לקראת מועד חשוב ב- 5 באוקטובר בתביעה ייצוגית בניירות הערך – DVLT
DVLT.summary: Rosen Law Firm announces class action securities lawsuits against Datavault AI Inc. (DVLT) and ARS Pharmaceuticals Inc. (SPRY), with October 5, 2026 deadline for investors to join. The Datavault AI lawsuit alleges false statements regarding business partnerships, platform activity, and undisclosed connections to a convicted felon. Investors who purchased securities during specified periods may be eligible for compensation.

SPRY.title: INVESTOR ALERT: Pomerantz Law Firm Reminds Investors with Losses on their Investment in ARS Pharmaceuticals, Inc. of Class Action Lawsuit and Upcoming Deadlines – SPRY
SPRY.summary: Pomerantz Law Firm has filed a class action lawsuit against ARS Pharmaceuticals (NASDAQ: SPRY) alleging securities fraud. The lawsuit was triggered after ARS announced on June 24, 2026, that it failed to secure expanded insurance coverage for its epinephrine nasal spray product 'neffy' through CVS Caremark by the July 1 deadline. The announcement caused ARS's stock to plummet 23.91% to $8.02 per share on June 25, 2026. Investors have until October 5, 2026, to request appointment as Lead Plaintiff.

SPRY.title: ARS PHARMACEUTICALS DEADLINE: ROSEN, TRUSTED INVESTOR COUNSEL, Encourages ARS Pharmaceuticals, Inc. Investors to Secure Counsel Before Important Deadline in Securities Class Action – SPRY
SPRY.summary: A securities class action lawsuit has been filed against ARS Pharmaceuticals (SPRY) for allegedly providing false and misleading statements regarding the timeline for expanded insurance coverage of its epinephrine nasal spray product 'neffy' through CVS Caremark. The company allegedly misled investors about a July 1, 2026 coverage start date, causing shareholders to purchase securities at artificially inflated prices. The lead plaintiff deadline is October 5, 2026.

CRAUY.title: Engineered for Confidence: FREELANDER 8 Brings Intelligent Technology to Diverse All-Terrain Conditions
CRAUY.summary: FREELANDER announced its FREELANDER 8 vehicle ahead of its global launch in Abu Dhabi on September 29, 2026. The vehicle features an Intelligent All-Terrain System (i-ATS) with nine modes for adaptive driving across various terrains, along with Super Intelligent Valet Parking (SIVP) for urban mobility. The vehicle has been tested in desert, gravel, rocky, and water crossing scenarios.

CRAUY.title: LEPAS Memperluas Kehadiran Global dengan Kemajuan di Berbagai Pasar
CRAUY.summary: LEPAS, Chery Auto's premium NEV brand, is expanding globally in 2026 with the L8 PHEV now available for pre-order across Europe. The brand has received multiple awards including 'Best Interior Design Award' at Turin Auto Show for the L6, and both L8 PHEV and L6 EV are shortlisted for World Car of the Year 2027. Parent company Chery Group has become the first Chinese automaker to export over 7 million vehicles and topped the UK new car brand rankings in August 2026.

CRAUY.title: LEPAS מרחיבה את נוכחותה הגלובלית עם התקדמות במספר שווקים
CRAUY.summary: LEPAS, Chery Auto's luxury vehicle brand, marks 2026 as its 'Year of Delivery' with expanding European operations and growing international recognition. The LEPAS L8 is now available for pre-order in multiple European markets, while L6 and L4 models are shipping in Southeast Asia. The brand has received multiple awards and recognition across Indonesia, UK, Italy, Spain, and Chile, with two models shortlisted for 2027 World Car of the Year. Parent company Chery Auto achieved a milestone of 7 million vehicle exports and ranked first in the UK new car market in August 2026.

CRAUY.title: レパス、複数の市場での進展により、グローバルな存在を拡大
CRAUY.summary: LEPAS, the premium NEV brand of Chery Auto, is expanding globally in 2026 with the L8 PHEV launching in European markets and L6/L4 models being delivered in Southeast Asia. KLAR.title: INVESTOR ALERT: Pomerantz Law Firm Investigates Claims On Behalf of Investors of Klarna Group plc - KLAR
KLAR.summary: Pomerantz LLP is investigating potential securities fraud claims against Klarna Group plc following the company's significant revenue guidance reduction announced on August 18, 2026. Klarna lowered its full-year 2026 revenue forecast from over $4.34 billion to $4.08-$4.16 billion and announced departures of its CFO and CMO, triggering a 22.81% stock price decline to $15.06 per share.

ARDX.title: ROSEN, SKILLED INVESTOR COUNSEL, Encourages Ardelyx, Inc. Investors to Secure Counsel Before Important Deadline in Securities Class Action - ARDX
ARDX.summary: Rosen Law Firm has filed a class action lawsuit on behalf of Ardelyx, Inc. investors who purchased stock between January 13, 2025 and August 6, 2026. The lawsuit alleges that Ardelyx provided materially false and misleading statements regarding commercial performance and growth prospects for its drugs XPHOZAH and IBSRELA, while concealing information about payer access barriers, prior authorization requirements, and step edit requirements that hindered patient access and prescription fulfillment. Investors who wish to serve as lead plaintiff must file by November 16, 2026.

ARDX.title: Bronstein, Gewirtz & Grossman LLC Urges Ardelyx, Inc. Investors to Act: Class Action Filed Alleging Investor Harm
ARDX.summary: A class action lawsuit has been filed against Ardelyx, Inc. alleging that the company made false and misleading statements regarding its commercial performance and growth prospects for drugs XPHOZAH and IBSRELA. The complaint claims Ardelyx failed to disclose increasing payer-related access barriers, stringent prior authorization requirements, and negative impacts on patient access and commercial performance during the class period from January 13, 2025 to August 6, 2026.

RDY.title: INVESTOR ALERT: Pomerantz Law Firm Investigates Claims On Behalf of Investors of Dr. Reddy’s Laboratories Limited - RDY
RDY.summary: Pomerantz LLP is investigating potential securities fraud claims against Dr. Reddy's Laboratories following the company's announcement of weak Q1 FY2027 earnings with only $0.06 EPS, attributed to a ₹2.4 billion provision for out-of-specification semaglutide batches. The disclosure triggered a 9.4% stock price decline on July 22, 2026.

RDY.title: INVESTOR ALERT: Pomerantz Law Firm Investigates Claims On Behalf of Investors of Emergent BioSolutions Inc. - EBS
RDY.summary: Pomerantz LLP announced investigations into potential securities fraud at Emergent BioSolutions, Klarna Group, and Dr. Reddy's Laboratories. Emergent reported a $191.3 million impairment charge on its NARCAN asset group and cut full-year revenue guidance by 10.8%, citing increased competitive intensity. The stock fell 29.58% on the news.

NEE.title: Is It Worth Investing in NextEra (NEE) Based on Wall Street's Bullish Views?
NEE.summary: While Wall Street analysts maintain a bullish average brokerage recommendation (ABR) of 2.00 (Buy) for NextEra Energy with 55% Strong Buy ratings, the article cautions against relying solely on these recommendations. The Zacks Rank system, which is based on earnings estimate revisions, rates NEE as a Rank #4 (Sell) due to a 0.1% decline in consensus earnings estimates over the past month. The article argues that brokerage analysts often exhibit positive bias due to vested interests, making the Zacks Rank a more reliable indicator of near-term stock performance.

The stock fell approximately 23% following the June 2026 SPO announcement, with all $207.9 million in proceeds going to Madison rather than the company. The three-bedroom, single-story home is priced at $889,000 and features modern contemporary architecture with premium amenities. The community offers 17 acres of greenbelt, proximity to Lacamas Lake Park, and convenient access to downtown Camas.

REGN.title: Co-development Deals in Pharmaceuticals and Biotechnology 2016-2026 | Pharmaceutical Co-Development Deals Reshape R&D Strategies as Companies Share Risk, Costs and Commercial Opportunities

The report covers deal structures, financial terms, the top 25 most active dealmakers, and provides access to actual SEC-filed contract documents. Co-development partnerships are highlighted as a strategic approach for companies to share R&D costs, risks, and commercial opportunities while accelerating product development timelines.

SNY.title: Recludix Pharma to Present at the Oppenheimer Private Life Sciences Company Showcase
SNY.summary: Recludix Pharma, a clinical-stage biotech company focused on inflammatory disease treatments, announced that its CEO and head of R&D will present at the Oppenheimer Private Life Sciences Company Showcase on September 29, 2026. The company is developing STAT6 and BTK inhibitors in partnership with Sanofi, with a Phase 1 study underway for REX-8756 targeting diseases like atopic dermatitis and asthma.

NTHI.title: NeOnc’s Delivery may Finally Change the Equation for Brain Cancer’s Next Frontier
NTHI.summary: NeOnc Technologies (NASDAQ: NTHI) is advancing NEO100, an intranasal-delivered therapy for IDH1-mutant gliomas, following promising Phase 2a results showing 48.9% six-month progression-free survival versus a 20% benchmark with no major toxicities. The company plans to seek FDA guidance on a registrational pathway, with potential broader implications for nose-to-brain drug delivery technology.

NTHI.title: NeOnc Charting New Nasal Route to Treating Brain Cancer
NTHI.summary: NeOnc Technologies (NASDAQ: NTHI) reported Phase 2a results for NEO100, an intranasal formulation of perillyl alcohol for recurrent high-grade glioma. The 24-patient study showed 48.9% six-month progression-free survival versus a 20% benchmark (p=0.0047), with median overall survival of 26.09 months. The novel nose-to-brain delivery approach aims to overcome blood-brain barrier challenges. While results are encouraging, the small sample size and open-label design warrant confirmation in larger randomized trials before regulatory approval.

FIGP.title: Forge to Acquire Becker’s Healthcare, the #1 Events and Digital Media Portfolio Shaping U.S. Healthcare Industry
FIGP.summary: Forge, a B2B events and media company formed by Apollo Funds' combination of Emerald and Questex, has agreed to acquire Becker's Healthcare from Pamlico Capital. The acquisition combines Becker's 16 annual conferences and digital publications with Forge's Fierce Healthcare and Life Sciences portfolio to create a scaled omnichannel platform serving healthcare decisionmakers across the full care continuum.

ZPTA.title: Zapata Introduces Quantum Pilot™ to Enable Systematic Discovery and Development of High-Value Quantum Applications
ZPTA.summary: Zapata Quantum announced early access to Quantum Pilot, a hardware-agnostic cloud-based platform designed to help enterprises identify and develop quantum computing applications with commercial value. The platform combines proprietary knowledge frameworks with AI-powered tools developed through collaborations with NVIDIA and University of Maryland to provide Quantum Application Intelligence, addressing the gap between advancing quantum hardware and enterprise ability to determine practical business applications.

PZZA.title: Deadline Alert: Papa John’s International, Inc. (PZZA) Shareholders Who Lost Money Urged To Contact Glancy Prongay Wolke & Rotter LLP About Securities Fraud Lawsuit
PZZA.summary: Papa John's International faces a securities fraud class action lawsuit for allegedly making materially false statements about its business transformation and growth outlook. ITOC.title: Portnoy Law Firm Announces Class Action on Behalf of iTonic Holdings, Ltd. Investors
ITOC.summary: The Portnoy Law Firm has filed a class action lawsuit on behalf of iTonic Holdings investors who purchased securities between September 5, 2024 and July 29, 2025. SKWD.title: Skyward Specialty Partners with SnapRefund to Set a New Standard for Claim Payments Using ClaimsSnap
SKWD.summary: SnapRefund and Skyward Specialty Insurance Group announced a strategic partnership to modernize claim payment execution through SnapRefund's ClaimsSnap platform. The collaboration aims to automate workflows, reduce manual handling, lower loss adjustment expenses, and improve operational efficiency as claims volumes scale.

BIO.title: Global Metabolomics Market to Reach US$9.01 Billion by 2035 as Precision Medicine, Biomarker Discovery and Advanced Analytics Unlock New Opportunities
BIO.summary: The global metabolomics market is projected to grow from USD 2.81 billion in 2025 to USD 9.01 billion by 2035, expanding at a CAGR of 12.36%. Growth is driven by precision medicine, biomarker discovery, and multiomics adoption, with oncology accounting for over 44% of the market. However, Q1 2026 faced challenges from geopolitical tensions, supply chain disruptions, and elevated logistics costs affecting laboratory budgets and procurement timelines.

BIO.title: Magnetic Bead Purification Kits Market Outlook 2026-2030: Investment Trends, Strategic Profiles and Revenue Share Outlook
BIO.summary: The global magnetic bead purification kits market reached $4.08 billion in 2025 with an 11.6% CAGR and is projected to grow to $6.73 billion by 2030 (10.5% CAGR) and $10.42 billion by 2035 (9.1% CAGR). Growth is driven by expanding genomics research, molecular diagnostics, and high-throughput screening. Semi-automated kits dominate at 51.8% market share, while Asia-Pacific is the fastest-growing region at 12% CAGR. Key challenges include skilled labor shortages and automation infrastructure dependencies.

ELV.title: How Centene's Strong Cash Flow Is Reshaping Its Balance Sheet
ELV.summary: Centene Corporation has significantly improved its financial position by generating nearly $8 billion in operating cash flow in the first half of 2026 and reducing its debt-to-capital ratio to 41.6% through $1.3 billion in senior note repurchases. KRYCY.title: Koryx Copper Completes PFS Drill Program, Announces Further Positive Infill Drill Results at the Haib Copper Project in Southern Namibia
KRYCY.summary: Koryx Copper has completed its PFS drill program at the Haib Copper Project in Namibia, reporting assay results from 18 drill holes totaling 7,074 meters. The results show consistent wide intercepts with notably higher-grade zones near surface, particularly in Target Area 3 where mining is scheduled to begin. The company's technical team is focused on completing geological modeling and estimation work for an updated Mineral Resource Estimate (MRE) and Preliminary Feasibility Study (PFS), both expected to be published before the end of 2026.

RHDTY.title: Ruihe Data Technology Holdings Limited Begins Trading on OTCQX Best Market

MAR.title: Marovi’s Evaluation Intelligence Takes Executive Hiring to New Levels
MAR.summary: Marovi, an AI-powered executive search platform, announced market momentum by unveiling its proprietary Evaluation Intelligence engine that automates candidate evaluation against role-specific requirements. The platform combines 40 years of recruiting expertise with technology to replace traditional search firms and sourcing methods. Key customers including Marriott International, Finastra, and Total Safety reported significant improvements in hiring speed, cost efficiency, and talent evaluation quality.

HCOW.title: Amplify ETFs Files for Amplify Pro Sports Private & Public Ownership ETF (PROS)

The fund will invest at least 80% of assets in equity securities tied to major professional sports leagues and organizations, with up to 15% in private investments.

ELDN.title: Eledon Presents Updated Long-Term Phase 2 BESTOW Extension Study Results at the International Congress of The Transplantation Society
ELDN.summary: Eledon Pharmaceuticals announced updated Phase 2 BESTOW extension study results showing tegoprubart-treated kidney transplant patients maintained significantly higher kidney function (71 vs. 58 mL/min/1.73 m² eGFR at 24 months) compared to tacrolimus, with zero rejections beyond six months versus seven in the tacrolimus arm. The FDA granted Fast Track designation to tegoprubart for kidney transplant rejection prevention, and the company plans to initiate the Phase 3 LEGACY trial in Q4 2026.

PETV.title: Michael Handley Joins PetVivo Holdings, Inc. Board of Directors
PETV.summary: PetVivo Holdings, Inc. announced the appointment of Michael K. Handley to its Board of Directors effective September 22, 2026. The company continues to focus on commercializing innovative medical devices and therapeutics for companion animals, with its lead product SPRYNG® currently available for commercial sale.

Oil ETFs (USO, BNO) have surged over 100% year-to-date due to backwardation benefits, while copper ETFs (CPER) benefit from tight supply and strong structural demand. Gold ETFs face headwinds from higher interest rates despite geopolitical support.

RXT.title: RACKSPACE TECHNOLOGY DEADLINE IN ONE WEEK: Bragar Eagel & Squire, P.C. Urges Rackspace Technology, Inc. Investors to Contact the Firm Before the September 28th Lead Plaintiff Deadline
RXT.summary: A class action lawsuit has been filed against Rackspace Technology for allegedly misleading investors about its enterprise AI efforts and their impact on profitability. The lawsuit claims Rackspace failed to disclose that AI initiatives would require significant reallocation of resources from its profitable Private Cloud segment, that Public Cloud revenue was declining due to customer migration to hyperscale platforms, and that these factors would materially impact fiscal year 2026 revenue. Investors who purchased shares between May 7, 2026 and July 8, 2026 can apply to be lead plaintiff by September 28, 2026.

RXT.title: Deadline Alert: Rackspace Technology, Inc. (RXT) Shareholders Who Lost Money Urged To Contact Glancy Prongay Wolke & Rotter LLP About Securities Fraud Lawsuit
RXT.summary: Rackspace Technology (RXT) faces a securities fraud class action lawsuit after the company revealed on July 9, 2026 that its AI investments would require significant resource reallocation, leading to a $150 million reduction in full-year 2026 revenue guidance and a 33.6% stock price decline. The lawsuit alleges defendants made materially false statements and failed to disclose that enterprise AI efforts would impact the profitable Private Cloud segment and that Public Cloud revenue was declining.

LGIH.title: LGI Homes & Terrata Homes Launches “Make Your Move” National Sales Event with Limited-Time Savings and Incentives
LGIH.summary: LGI Homes announced its 'Make Your Move' National Sales Event starting September 18, 2026, offering limited-time incentives including builder-paid closing costs, included upgrades, and special interest rate incentives on select move-in ready homes across LGI Homes and Terrata Homes communities nationwide. The luxury brand Terrata Homes is offering up to $25,000 in Flex Cash on select homes.

AVAV.title: Bragar Eagel & Squire, P.C. is Investigating Aerovironment, Inc. on Behalf of Long-Term Stockholders and Encourages Investors to Contact the Firm
AVAV.summary: Law firm Bragar Eagel & Squire is investigating Aerovironment Inc. on behalf of long-term stockholders following a class action complaint filed in May 2026. The lawsuit alleges that the company's board made false statements and failed to disclose material facts regarding potential competition for work related to the Satellite Communication Augmentation Resource program and U.S. Space Force satellite modernization efforts.

CXT.title: Strength Seen in Figure Technology (FIGR): Can Its 5.3% Jump Turn into More Strength?
CXT.summary: Figure Technology (FIGR) shares jumped 5.3% to $35.49 on strong volume, driven by growth momentum, the Kiavi acquisition, and an AI-powered lending partnership with Sierra. The company is expected to report quarterly earnings of $0.33 per share with revenues up 59.9% year-over-year. With a 1.6% upward revision in EPS estimates over the past 30 days and a Zacks Rank #1 (Strong Buy) rating, analysts are optimistic about continued strength.

PRCT.title: Deadline Alert: PROCEPT BioRobotics Corporation (PRCT) Shareholders Who Lost Money Urged To Contact Glancy Prongay Wolke & Rotter LLP About Securities Fraud Lawsuit
PRCT.summary: A class action lawsuit has been filed against PROCEPT BioRobotics Corporation for allegedly making materially false statements about its business between February 2024 and February 2026. The company allegedly used an undisclosed discount program to artificially inflate handpiece sales, leading to excess inventory of over 10,000 units. Stock price declined significantly following three earnings announcements revealing lower-than-expected sales and inventory issues. Shareholders have until September 22, 2026 to file lead plaintiff motions.

PRCT.title: Kaplan Fox Encourages PROCEPT BioRobotics Corporation (NASDAQ: PRCT) Investors Seeking Recovery to Contact the Firm Before September 22, 2026
PRCT.summary: Kaplan Fox has filed a class action lawsuit against PROCEPT BioRobotics Corporation for allegedly misleading investors about the relationship between handpiece unit sales and procedures. The complaint alleges that undisclosed discount programs artificially inflated reported U.S. handpiece unit sales and revenues by pulling forward demand. Investors who purchased PROCEPT common stock between February 28, 2024 and February 25, 2026 may be eligible to participate in the class action, with a deadline of September 22, 2026 to seek a lead plaintiff role.

ALAR.title: ROSEN, TOP-RANKED INVESTOR COUNSEL, Encourages AppLovin Corporation Investors to Secure Counsel Before Important Deadline in Securities Class Action – APP
ALAR.summary: Rosen Law Firm has filed securities class action lawsuits against AppLovin Corporation, Bloom Energy Corporation, and Alarum Technologies Ltd., alleging that defendants made false and misleading statements regarding product development, AI capabilities, and business performance during their respective class periods. Investors who purchased securities during the specified periods may be eligible for compensation.

JOBY.title: JOBY Makes History With Fully Autonomous Flight Across the United States
JOBY.summary: Joby Aviation successfully completed a 3,199-mile autonomous flight across the United States with zero control inputs from an onboard pilot. The converted Cessna Caravan handled taxiing, takeoffs, navigation, and landings under remote supervision, demonstrating the company's autonomy technology capabilities built on more than 400 flights and 800 automated flight hours. The achievement showcases potential applications in commercial freight, medical transport, disaster response, and defense logistics.

ARM.title: Tech Stocks Break Out: The Next Leg of the Bull Market
ARM.summary: After four and a half months of consolidation, technology stocks are breaking out to the upside, led by semiconductor and AI-related companies. Despite concerns about AI safety and higher interest rates, the underlying economics of AI infrastructure investment remain strong, with demand for computing power continuing to expand beyond GPUs to CPUs, memory, and networking equipment. Bitcoin's rally signals returning risk appetite among investors.

MCRI.title: “Mike & Molly” Star Billy Gardell Brings His Stand-Up Comedy to Atlantis Casino Resort Spa October 3
MCRI.summary: Comedian Billy Gardell will perform at Atlantis Casino Resort Spa in Reno on October 3, 2026. Tickets start at $39, with a limited-time Buy One, Get One Free offer available. Atlantis is an award-winning luxury resort owned by Monarch Casino & Resort, Inc., recognized as the #1 Reno resort on TripAdvisor and holding AAA Four Diamond designation.

VALU.title: Value Line's Q1 Earnings Down Y/Y on Lower Publishing Revenue
VALU.summary: Value Line, Inc. (VALU) reported Q1 FY2027 earnings of 50 cents per share, down 27.5% year-over-year. Publishing revenues declined 6.4% to $8.1 million, while net income fell 27.9% to $4.7 million. The company faced headwinds from lower circulation, reduced investment gains, and declining assets under management at its Eulav Asset Management division, though the stock gained 4.3% post-earnings.

UMC.title: GlobalFoundries Drives Gross Margin Expansion: Can the Momentum Last?
UMC.summary: GlobalFoundries reported strong Q2 2026 results with gross profit rising 24% to $505M and IFRS gross margin expanding to 28.3%. The company is benefiting from favorable business mix, manufacturing productivity gains, and strong demand in communications infrastructure and data centers, which surged 62% year-over-year. However, sustaining this momentum will require balancing profitability with investments in future growth and continued movement toward higher-value technologies.

FITB.title: Huntington Rewards Shareholders With Higher 2027 Buyback Plan
FITB.summary: Huntington Bancshares (HBAN) plans $550 million in share repurchases for 2026 and $1.3-$1.4 billion for 2027, increasing buybacks by $200 million due to a recalibrated lower loan-growth outlook of 6% versus previous 8%-9% expectations. The company maintains strong liquidity of $16 billion and has $2.95 billion remaining under its $3 billion repurchase authorization. Acquisition synergies from Veritex and Cadence integrations are generating stronger-than-expected revenue synergies, supporting earnings growth and shareholder returns.

The article recommends high-quality dividend stocks that offer steady income growth and can help offset inflation, while cautioning investors to watch out for fees when considering dividend-focused funds or ETFs.

BSX.title: Will Boston Scientific's Upcoming Launches Fuel the Next Growth Phase?
BSX.summary: Boston Scientific plans multiple product launches through 2028 across Interventional Cardiology, EP, and CRM segments, including SEISMIQ 4CE, FARAWAVE Ultra, and PRECEDENT platforms. However, the company expects flat global EP growth in H2 2026 due to competitive pressures, with momentum expected to return in H2 2027. BSX stock has underperformed the industry over the past 12 months and carries a Zacks Rank #5 (Strong Sell) rating.

AMKR.title: Amkor's AI and HPC Packaging Demand Grows: Can Growth Continue?
AMKR.summary: Amkor Technology reported record Q2 2026 revenues of $1.90 billion, up 26% year-over-year, driven by strong AI and data-center demand. The company is advancing advanced packaging technologies including 2.5D, HDFO, and co-packaged optics through partnerships with TSMC and NVIDIA. Amkor guided Q3 sales of $1.95-$2.05 billion with gross margins of 18.5%-19.5%, while announcing a $12 billion Phase 2 expansion of its Arizona campus. Competitors TSMC and Intel are also investing heavily in advanced packaging capabilities to capture AI/HPC growth opportunities.

APLD.title: TTMI vs. APLD: Which AI-Infrastructure Stock Has More Upside Potential?
APLD.summary: TTM Technologies (TTMI) and Applied Digital (APLD) both benefit from AI infrastructure growth, but TTMI emerges as the stronger investment. TTMI's Data Center & Networking sales surged 91% year-over-year with N+M PCB technology ramping to $600M in H2 2026, while maintaining profitability and attractive valuation. APLD, despite $36B in contracted revenues, faces persistent losses, heavy capital requirements, and customer concentration risks. TTMI trades at 2.41X forward sales versus APLD's 7.36X, earning a Zacks Rank #1 (Strong Buy) versus APLD's Rank #5 (Strong Sell).

NSPR.title: InspireMD Announces Amendments to Certain Series J and Series K Warrants, Providing Potential Gross Proceeds of Up to $11 Million
NSPR.summary: InspireMD amended Series J and K warrants affecting approximately 14.3 million shares, aligning the exercise trigger with anticipated FDA approval of CGuard Prime 80 cm expected in Q4 2026. The amendments could provide up to $11 million in gross proceeds to fund the commercial launch of the TCAR product, which targets an addressable market of over 35,000 annual procedures in the U.S.

DXST.title: Decent Holding Announces Planned Tiered Subscription Service Model for Suncare Platform
DXST.summary: Decent Holding Inc. (NASDAQ: DXST) announced plans to introduce a tiered subscription service model with AI-assisted health management and smart devices across its Suncare platform, which operates 623 community service locations with approximately 200,000 paid members as of August 2026. The company is shifting focus from network expansion to deepening service offerings through three subscription tiers (Essential Health Management at ~RMB 500/month, Enhanced Home Health Services at ~RMB 1,990/month, and Advanced Assisted Care at ~RMB 2,990/month). The rollout will be gradual through selected locations, with services provided by third-party healthcare providers rather than the company itself.

KRBPQ.title: Gainey McKenna & Egleston Announces the Proposed Class Action Settlement on Behalf of Purchasers of Kiromic BioPharma Inc. common stock - KRBPQ
KRBPQ.summary: A proposed class action settlement of $1,225,000 has been approved by the U.S. District Court for the Southern District of New York on behalf of purchasers of Kiromic BioPharma Inc. common stock. The settlement resolves allegations that company defendants made false and misleading statements during the class period from June 25, 2021 to February 2, 2022. A fairness hearing is scheduled for December 17, 2026.

OTCM.title: Pecoy Copper Corp. Begins Trading on OTCQX Best Market
OTCM.summary: Pecoy Copper Corp., a Canadian exploration and development company focused on advancing a major copper-gold-molybdenum porphyry deposit in Peru, has upgraded from OTCQB to trade on the OTCQX Best Market under the symbol PCUUF. The upgrade reflects the company's progress in meeting high financial standards and corporate governance requirements.
